newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield up at 7.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield up at 7.47 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, sold 90-day treasury bills worth 1.01 billion taka with a corresponding yield at 7.47 percent, up from the previous 7.41 percent, at an auction on Wednesday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price against the bill was 98.17 taka per 100 taka against 98.18 taka, previously.

The bank also sold 30-day treasury bills worth 853 million taka with an annual yield at 7.11 percent against 6.82 percent, previously. The weighted average price was 99.41 taka against the previous 99.43 taka.
